title: CIDRe: A Reference-Free Multi-Aspect Criterion for Code Comment Quality Measurement

bias_targets.methodology: The paper identifies and mitigates English-language bias in existing code comment evaluation metrics (like STASIS and MIDQ) by developing a language-agnostic metric (CIDRe) and specifically evaluating it on a Russian-language dataset (StRuCom) to ensure cross-lingual applicability.

The paper evaluates LLM-as-a-judge positional bias during side-by-side model comparisons by prompting the judge (GPT-4o-mini) twice with the candidate responses in reversed order, recording victories only when the outcomes are consistent.
